test_title: PYST 63: RRB Group D - GS (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about epithelial tissue is correct?

options.text: Epithelial tissue forms a protective covering and regulates material exchange.
Epithelial tissue cells have large intercellular spaces and form a loose sheet.
Epithelial tissue does not play any role in material exchange in the body.
Epithelial tissue mainly connects bones and muscles.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Epithelial tissue forms a protective covering and regulates material exchange**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Epithelial tissue** is a primary tissue type that covers the **external surfaces** of the body and lines **internal organs** and cavities. Its primary role is to act as a barrier and provide **protection** against mechanical injury, pathogens, and dehydration. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• The cells in epithelial tissue are **tightly packed** and form a continuous sheet. They have an extremely small amount of **cementing material** between them and almost no **intercellular spaces**. ***Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.***
 
• This tissue is crucial for **regulating the exchange of materials** between the body and the external environment, as well as between different parts of the body. The **permeability** of the epithelial cells allows for the controlled movement of substances. ***Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.***
